principle: The Maxey0 Context Plane: one graph, one rule set, served by the Maxey0 Context Plane MCP server, which feeds the Human0 app. Maxey0 orchestrates; every specialised agent is a MaxeyN agent. Every thread runs Domain -> Topic -> Concept -> Skill with exactly one parent per node. Differentiation happens below the skill: a skill has several MaxeyN agents (roles primary/checker/support), an agent may hold MCP servers. Agents and MCP servers are global entities, not per-topic copies.

agent_merge_rule: agents with the same name (case-insensitive) are one agent only within the same home topic (the topic of the pack that defined them; topic merges count as one topic; all base-graph agents share the home 'maxey0_base'). The same name in different topics stays separate agents, because a generic role such as 'Data Analyst Agent' means different work in different fields.
mcp_rule: MCP servers form one registry keyed by directory uuid (rows without one get 'local:<name>'). A server a pack lists is listed on every topic that received that pack's concepts: the pack's own topic plus the topics its concepts were merged or moved into (topic_mcp). A server is attached to an agent when the cosine between the server and one of the agent's skills (skill text + agent name) is >= similarity.thresholds.mcp_link; the top mcp_link_top_k agents qualify, among the agents of those topics (or among Maxey0 System agents for base-graph rows). Links are DERIVED and carry their cosine. No fallback links are invented. A base-graph server with no qualifying agent is trimmed as unused.
related_rule: concepts in different topics with cosine >= similarity.thresholds.related get a 'related' link (kept as separate concepts)

dropped_concepts.registry: its only skill (repo-decomp) has no agents; nothing left to run

id_rules.reason: every id is unique across all levels so trace(node_id) is unambiguous

maxey_agent_key.rule: every agent key is MaxeyN. Base-graph keys (Maxey0 orchestrator, Maxey00 superposition, ... up to Maxey801) are kept. Every other agent's key comes from SCW1/maxey_registry.json (source key -> MaxeyN, seeded from the v3 deployment), so keys never change between builds; agents new to the registry get the next free number in graph order and are appended. The source key is kept as legacy_key.

similarity.definition: One tokenizer (lowercase, [a-z0-9]+ words, stop-words and words of <=2 letters removed, trailing plural 's' stripped). Corpus = every concept (label + desc + keywords), skill (label + desc) and MCP row (name + desc + tool names). Weight = (1 + ln tf) * idf, idf = ln((N + 1)/(df + 1)) + 1, vectors L2-normalised; similarity = cosine. The same method scores search/route_task, agent->MCP links and related concepts; only the threshold differs by use. A pair only counts as similar when the two sides share at least min(2, number of terms in the shorter side) terms, so one rare shared word is not evidence.

calibration.related: 0.40: 57 cross-topic pairs. At 0.40 the pairs are still genuine (Mathematical Methods ~ Linear Algebra; Language Variation ~ Psycholinguistics); 0.45 would keep 33.
calibration.mcp_link: 0.10: below it, links are mixed (SciSpace -> Separations Process Engineer 0.089, Microsoft Learn -> Logic Agent 0.094); from 0.10 up, mostly right (DeepL -> Japanese Translation Agent 0.119, Felt Maps -> Electoral Geography Agent 0.116). Cost: some correct low-scoring links are lost (DeepL -> Hebrew and Yiddish Language Agent 0.094).
calibration.search_min: 0.08, the matched/unmatched threshold the Context Plane page used; checked against sample queries in tests.
calibration.status: JUDGMENT: thresholds were read off score distributions by inspection, not fitted to labelled data.
calibration.coverage_rule: added after a routing check: without it, 'hello there friend' routed to False Friend Detector (0.30) and 'IBS versus Crohn disease' to a Korean grammar skill (0.23) on one shared word, scoring above true matches such as 'differentiate x squared times sine x' (0.24).

declared_mcp_links.reason: Maxey0 is the orchestrator and the 'Maxey0 (artifact + SCW store)' server is Maxey0's own SCW/artifact store; the orchestrator holds it by design, not by text similarity.

declared_mcp_rule: links in declared_mcp_links are added as basis 'declared:spec' (score null) in addition to the derived links; the build fails if either end is missing.
concept_move_rule: a moved concept keeps its id, label and skills; only its topic changes

topic_priority.source: stated by Human0 on 2026-10-29: physics is the most important topic outside the Work and Maxey0 System domains
topic_priority.use: declared, visible and optional: route_task and search use it only to break exact score ties, and only when use_priority is true (default). It never changes scores or structure.

skill_agent_overrides.reason: found in the live test chat: the Quantum Consistency Checker Agent fits a quantum checker role better than a Data Analyst Agent

skill_agent_override_rule: applied after MaxeyN keys are assigned; the build fails if the skill, the 'from' agent in that role, or the 'to' agent is missing
checker_rule: On every skill, each checker agent also holds the MCP servers its primary agent holds for that skill's topic, so the checker can re-run the primary's work independently instead of verifying by reasoning alone. These links have basis 'inherited:checker-of-primary', carry the primary's score and a 'via' field naming the primary and the skill. A checker that already holds a server by its own derived or declared link keeps that link. Stated by Human0 on 2026-10-29.
domain_topics_rule: a topic listed under domain_topics[d] belongs to domain d; otherwise Maxey0 topics -> maxey0-system, work_topics -> work, the rest -> disciplines

open_questions.location-resolution: Is an MCP server a location? Hypothesis: an MCP server is an address (endpoint); a location is host + region + environment. Placeholder concept env-human0-dev; no rule reads it.
open_questions.dev-server-name: The Human0 development server needs a new name (owner).

maxey0_topic_rule: Maxey0 is one topic (owner decision 2026-10-31). Its 15 base concepts are merged to 8: orchestration+agentic loops+superposition; I/O contract+A2A/MCP message contracts; tiered memory+OKF knowledge graph; policy gates+run tracing+run evaluation; structured reasoning+claim verification; runtime infrastructure, Structured Context Windows and latent space stay. Former topic ids maxey0-runtime, maxey0-memory-context, maxey0-assurance no longer exist.
